reward: Monthly sum of daily excess returns divided by training reference volatility, minus half a training-calibrated variance penalty times their squares. This is a risk-adjusted reward proxy; candidate selection uses actual validation Sharpe.
timing: Use prior-close features. Reallocate after the first session of each month; that session's market return belongs to the previous allocation.
costs: Additional proportional resizing estimate: previous source holdings at execution close, 0.10 vol points times gross vega, 1bp stock hedge notional, and $0.03 per outstanding option contract, per source NAV. Original source trading costs remain in returns.
selection: Highest 2018-2021 validation excess Sharpe among six Q procedures per ATM variant; ties prefer longer window and larger penalty. No test-period search.
scope: Fitted Q-iteration over fractional units of frozen strategy return indices, with prior allocation and action-dependent future resizing costs. No shared option inventory, new integer quantities, netting or broker margin replay.
history: Source funded ledgers begin in 2018. Initial policies use a causal rolling risk-balance fallback until 12 completed, feature-ready months exist. Historical test dates have been examined previously.
